d:
Hafta Vasuli (1998) is an intense 90s Bollywood action drama featuring Jackie Shroff, Aditya Pancholi, and Ayub Khan. The film revolves around a courageous battle against political corruption, extortion, and underworld crime, showcasing high-voltage action, drama, and strong emotional conflicts.
Hafta vasuli (1998) ek behatrin bolivud ekshan drama philm hai. ismen jaiki shroph, aadity pancholi aur ayyub khan mukhy bhumikaon men hain. yah kahani bhrashtachar, julm aur rajniti ke khilaph khare hone vale janbaj naykon ke sangharsh aur unke bich ki atut deshbhakti ko bakhubi darshati hai.
